summary: The North Monterey County Unified School District urges the Commission to reject any proposal that would terminate or limit the E-Rate Program, emphasizing the disproportionate impact on rural connectivity, the widening of the Homework Gap, and the violation of universal service mandates. The school district argues that without E-Rate intervention, rural districts would be forced to divert funds away from student instruction to maintain network infrastructure and digital tools.
